modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cyclonesk: A client-side visual enhancement mod featuring animated skies, music lyric overlays, and custom visual styles.
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.sky: Words appear in 3D in the sky. Blocks in front hide them.
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.world: The lyrics float right in front of you, wherever you look (best for PvP).
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.auto: In the world while you fight, otherwise in the sky.
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.screen: Flat on the screen with a light 3D tilt.
valence.lyrics.mode.desc.bar: No 3D text, only the bar at the top.
valence.perf.maxfps.desc: Turns off everything that costs FPS. Switch it off and all your settings come back.
valence.perf.maxfps.on: On: sky details, particles, shooting stars, star signs, lightning and lyric glow are off, sky quality is Max FPS.
valence.perf.maxfps.off: Off: your own effect settings are used.

valence.lyrics.follow.desc: On: the lyrics move with you when you turn. Off: they stay where they appeared.
valence.sky.quality.desc: Auto lowers the sky detail by itself when your FPS drop and raises it again when they are high.
valence.lyrics.where.info.0: Sky: the lyrics are written big into the sky above you.
valence.lyrics.where.info.1: Floating: the lyrics float right in front of you, wherever you look (best for PvP).

valence.info.changelog.110:
v1.1.0
â€¢ All skies reworked: no more line at the horizon (fog and sky now match exactly), light shafts reach all the way down, cleaner aurora and galaxy
â€¢ Sky resolution setting (Auto / Sharp / Balanced / Max FPS) and the sky is only repainted when needed: much more FPS
â€¢ New sky preview: "Preview" on every picture, camera flies up to the sky, look around with the mouse, settings on the right
â€¢ Lyrics: word-perfect sync (every word appears when it is sung), smoother timing, finer offset
â€¢ 5 menu sounds: Glass, Creamy Keys, Clicky Keys, Bubble, Minecraft
â€¢ One click Sodium install for more FPS
â€¢ Menu opens and closes without pictures jumping

valence.info.changelog.120:
v1.2.0
â€¢ New sky engine: 20 skies with weather (snow, rain, thunder, petals, embers, fireflies) that run on every graphics card, incl. a custom sky editor
â€¢ Lyrics in 3D in the sky or floating around you, 22 fonts, 3 animations, glow, beat pulse, song intro, translation
â€¢ Spotify: automatic on Windows (no login) or via the Spotify Web API, album cover, word-perfect sync
â€¢ New top bar with clock, ping, FPS and karaoke line, glass hotbar, custom crosshairs
â€¢ Cosmetics: 27 hats, trails, aura, beat border and kill animations
â€¢ Automatic FPS control, Chill / PvP profile, FPS boost

v1.3.0
